programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: In Ethiopia, one and a half million people are blind.Martyna had the opportunity to meet representatives of the charity organization "Himalayan Cataract Project", which deals with free sight restoration for people from the poorest regions of the world.She accompanied several women in their everyday lives.The blind Muria, a nurse named Abeba, and the talented doctor Somega.The traveler had the opportunity to observe the course of eye surgery at the Ouiha hospital.She also attended a school for blind children in Mekele who learn Braille.They dream of being journalists and telling people about their life in Ethiopia.These dreams can come true thanks to the Himalayan Cataract Project foundation.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska and her team visit the Nyaru Menteng center, where orphaned orangutans find shelter.About sixty thousand representatives of this species live in Borneo.Their population is decreasing at an alarming rate, which is related to the devastation of the environment.At the Indonesian rehabilitation center, Martyna meets several exceptional women: the director of the center, Michelle, and the orangutan caregivers who take care of the little ones 24 hours a day and teach them the art of surviving in the wild.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: In picturesque Tanzania, the host will meet Naiyoma Rae, one of the few women pilots in Africa.The heroine of the episode lives in Arusha, but is rarely at home because she flies passenger planes almost every day and spends many hours in the clouds.Naiyoma is an extremely strong person who is not afraid of challenges.She will tell Martyna about, among other things, what animals disturb the most when landing and why, about her first solo flight and about numerous marriage offers from male passengers.In this episode, the host will also visit a coffee plantation, taste the sugar cane, and local women will do their hair according to the local fashion.

programs.title: Aloha, new home
programs.desc: Spouses Kamohai and Tristyn Kalama are native Hawaiians whose passion and mission is to renovate abandoned houses on the island of Oahu.Contrary to appearances, it is not just pleasant work in beautiful natural surroundings.Many of these properties are in a deplorable condition due to moisture, wind and sun.Renovations are additionally complicated by difficult terrain and changeable weather.However, the reward for designers is the end result, which is worth every moment spent renovating these amazing buildings.

programs.title: Marooned with Ed Stafford 2
programs.desc: Former British Army captain and experienced traveler Ed Stafford continues to overcome new challenges.He became known to viewers as a steadfast man who is able to cope with any extreme situation.So far, among others:he underwent a test of survival for 60 days on one of the uninhabited islands of Fiji, where he had no supplies of food, clothing or necessary equipment.Moreover, he walked the trail leading along the Amazon River, which earned him a place in history and the Guinness Book of Records.In the next series of the program "Ed Stafford Beyond Civilization", the traveler once again sets off to the most hostile corners of the world, including the Gobi Desert in Mongolia and the crocodile-infested Guatemalan jungle.
